answer: Because the timing is logged against the sable challenge, the juniper audit can replay the jade history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 300 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 514 identities would post 4594 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
